query: How many days of paid vacation do full-time employees receive per year?
reference_answer: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid vacation per year, accruing at 1.67 days per month.

query: How many unused vacation days can be carried over to the next year?
reference_answer: Unused vacation may be carried over to the next calendar year, up to a maximum of 5 days.

query: How many days per week can employees work remotely?
reference_answer: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval.

query: What is the company match for the 401(k) retirement plan?
reference_answer: The 401(k) plan has a 4% company match after one year of employment.

query: What is the minimum password length?
reference_answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.

query: How quickly must security incidents be reported to the SOC?
reference_answer: Security incidents must be reported to the Security Operations Center within one hour of discovery.

query: How long must business records be retained?
reference_answer: Business records must be retained for a minimum of 7 years.

query: How quickly are terminated employee accounts disabled?
reference_answer: Terminated employee accounts are disabled within 2 hours of separation.

query: How many approving reviews does a pull request need before merging?
reference_answer: Every pull request needs at least two approving reviews.

query: When do engineers join the on-call rotation?
reference_answer: Engineers join the on-call rotation after completing 90 days.

query: What is the annual learning budget for engineers?
reference_answer: Engineers receive a $2,000 annual learning budget for conferences, courses, and books.

query: What is the minimum password length, and how large is the home office stipend for remote workers?
reference_answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters, and remote workers get a one-time $500 home office stipend.
